description: This PHP class 'Skill' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and represents a display field for skills within the reporting module of the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to specify related DTO class, entity aliases, and fields for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: A report display field class for skills, providing DTO class info, entity aliases, and related fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the data transfer object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in database queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields included in this display field.
